name: release-workflow
body: Release workflow: GitHub Actions workflow (`.github/workflows/release.yml`) triggered by a consented tag (human-created, or agent-created under explicit per-action consent). It builds one binary per supported target (darwin/arm64, darwin/amd64, windows/amd64, windows/arm64, linux/amd64, linux/arm64 — each only if its native runner is available), gates on native-e2e-ci, publishes assets and checksums to the public GitHub Release, then regenerates the Homebrew formula (plain release-download url+sha256 per arch, through Homebrew's default downloader) and Scoop manifest (standard `architecture` 64bit/arm64 url+hash, installed by Scoop's standard installer) covering each target actually released, and pushes them as a manifest-only commit confined to `Formula/` and `bucket/` (global.constraint.humans-push-and-tag). The workflow's writes stay manifest-only and it reacts to a consented tag, leaving code pushes and tag creation to the maintainer. Its comments (and those in ci.yml / native-e2e.yml) describe the repo as public.
